rule: Exact shipped ground filtering; bounds enclose every retained indexed vertex in every class. Original horizontal extents retained/expanded; vertical extrema rounded outward with a 1 m margin for triangle chord sag. Empty and unprocessed content bounds unchanged. Ancestors enclose all child bounds. Native model bytes/geometry/materials are not replaced.
scope: Offline retained-source candidate. No additional acquisition. Native model URLs and bytes unchanged. Local metadata can replace upstream tileset only after browser acceptance.
unprocessedPolicy: Original leaf bounds unchanged for all 1,146 unprocessed and 20 filtered-empty tiles. Ancestors union all processed and unprocessed child height ranges.
byteMetric: cachedSourceGzipBytes is recompressed gzip estimate, not original upstream transfer. Per-source originalEncodedBytes comes from retained acquisition HTTP Content-Length when available.
